name: Financial & Alien Readiness Framework
description: A test framework to assess financial health and alien invasion preparedness

dimensions.name: Financial Health
dimensions.description: Assessment of overall financial health indicators

criteria.name: Liquidity
criteria.question: How strong is the company's liquidity position?

scoring_definitions.1: Very poor liquidity with significant cash flow concerns
scoring_definitions.2: Below average liquidity with some cash flow challenges
scoring_definitions.3: Adequate liquidity to meet short-term obligations
scoring_definitions.4: Strong liquidity position with good cash reserves
scoring_definitions.5: Excellent liquidity with substantial cash reserves and flexible access to capital

criteria.name: Solvency
criteria.question: How solid is the company's long-term solvency position?

scoring_definitions.1: High risk of insolvency with concerning debt levels
scoring_definitions.2: Below average solvency with elevated debt concerns
scoring_definitions.3: Adequate solvency with manageable debt levels
scoring_definitions.4: Strong solvency with conservative debt structure
scoring_definitions.5: Excellent solvency with minimal debt and strong balance sheet

dimensions.name: Strategic Initiatives
dimensions.description: Assessment of key strategic initiatives and investments

criteria.name: AI Investment
criteria.question: How robust is the company's investment in AI technologies?

scoring_definitions.1: Minimal or no investment in AI technologies
scoring_definitions.2: Limited investment in AI with unclear strategy
scoring_definitions.3: Moderate investment in AI with developing strategy
scoring_definitions.4: Significant investment in AI with clear strategy
scoring_definitions.5: Industry-leading investment in AI with innovative applications

criteria.name: Leadership
criteria.question: How effective is the company's leadership in executing strategy?

scoring_definitions.1: Ineffective leadership with poor strategic execution
scoring_definitions.2: Below average leadership with inconsistent execution
scoring_definitions.4: Strong leadership with consistent strategic execution
scoring_definitions.5: Exceptional leadership with outstanding strategic execution

dimensions.name: Extraordinary Risks
dimensions.description: Assessment of preparedness for highly unusual risks

criteria.name: Alien Invasion Preparedness
criteria.question: How prepared is the company for a potential alien invasion?

scoring_definitions.1: No alien invasion contingency plans whatsoever
scoring_definitions.3: Some general disaster plans that could apply to alien scenarios
scoring_definitions.4: Specific plans addressing potential extraterrestrial contact
scoring_definitions.5: Comprehensive alien invasion response protocols with designated bunkers and communication systems
